summary: Reproduced React #527 (and related null useState crash) with @module-federation/vite 1.21.6 + runtime 2.9.0 when React family is shared as singletons across patch-skewed 19.2.x installs.

console_messages.forced_remote_a_react_dom_loadShare: Minified React error #527; visit https://react.dev/errors/527?args[]=19.2.8&args[]=19.2.4 for the full message or use the non-minified dev environment for full errors and additional helpful warnings.
console_messages.forced_remote_b_react_dom_loadShare: Minified React error #527; visit https://react.dev/errors/527?args[]=19.2.8&args[]=19.2.6 for the full message or use the non-minified dev environment for full errors and additional helpful warnings.

containers_crashed.host: YES — blank page; TypeError Cannot read properties of null (reading useState). Stack shows host App rendered by remote_c react-dom/client loadShare + remote_c react loadShare.
containers_crashed.remote_a: Host never mounts remotes (host crashes first). Forcing remote_a react-dom/client loadShare under host share scope throws literal Minified React error #527 (react 19.2.8 vs react-dom 19.2.4).
containers_crashed.remote_b: Same pattern: forcing remote_b loadShare throws #527 (19.2.8 vs 19.2.6).
containers_crashed.remote_c: Its loadShare modules participate in the natural host crash (same 19.2.8 label, mismatched module instances / null dispatcher).

deviations: Used Vite 6.3.5 classic (not Nitro) as preferred.
hostInitInjectLocation: entry on all apps including host.
DTS plugin warned about missing tsconfig.json (non-fatal; builds succeeded).
minify:false so stacks are readable; React still emits Minified React error #527 string.

Natural host navigation crashes with null useState before remotes mount; literal #527 proven by importing remote_a/remote_b react-dom/client loadShare chunks under host share scope (same eager __prebuild__ evaluation path).
pnpm 9.15.9 + Node 22.23.2 (system default Node 20 + global pnpm 11 were incompatible).
react-dom package itself not in shared list (only react-dom/client) per handoff.
